The '''Bothan Embassy''' was located in the [[Bothan Quarter]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and contained the offices of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] ambassador to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].
